scope: targeted primary-source search, not systematic review

sources.title: Keep the Balance: A Parameter-Efficient Symmetrical Framework for RGB+X Semantic Segmentation
sources.read: official abstract, paper introduction excerpt, author repository README; not reproduced
sources.idea: Both modalities receive representation capacity; symmetric adaptation and sparse cross-modal fusion are prior art.
sources.use: Two independently supervised modal encoders; plain symmetric fusion as mandatory control, not claimed novelty.

sources.title: Boosting Multimodal Learning via Disentangled Gradient Learning
sources.authors: Shicai Wei, Chunbo Luo, Yang Luo
sources.read: method equations 9–15 and algorithm, RGB-D experiment section; not reproduced
sources.idea: Separate encoder and fusion optimization; gradient suppression differs from negative cosine conflict.
sources.use: Joint versus detached fusion gradients as existing-method-inspired control; private heads here differ from original shared classifier modality dropout.

sources.title: MFFNet: a wavelet transform-based multimodal frequency fusion network for remote sensing semantic segmentation
sources.authors: Chao Li, Haitao Lyu, Weipeng Jing, Ye Yuan, Guangliang Cheng
sources.read: publisher abstract and method sections 3.1–3.2 excerpts; not reproduced
sources.idea: Spatial/frequency feature fusion and multiscale high-frequency fusion already exist.
sources.use: Frequency basis needs spatial matched control and bidirectional ablation; no novelty claim for adding Haar.

sources.title: DIS2: Disentanglement Meets Distillation with Classwise Attention for Robust Remote Sensing Segmentation under Missing Modalities
sources.authors: Nhi Kieu, Kien Nguyen, Arnold Wiliem, Clinton Fookes, Sridha Sridharan
sources.status: arXiv metadata states accepted WACV 2026 Computer Vision for Earth Observation Workshop; not main conference
sources.read: methods 3.1–3.3, experimental setting and three modality states; not reproduced
sources.idea: Private and compensation representations; evaluates full, optical missing and height missing.
sources.use: Bidirectional missingness and classwise contributions necessary; current plan omits compensation distillation to isolate interaction.

sources.title: Robust Multispectral Semantic Segmentation under Missing or Full Modalities via Structured Latent Projection
sources.authors: Irem Ulku, Erdem Akagündüz, Ömer Özgür Tanrıöver
sources.status: arXiv preprint 2604.15856; no confirmed venue in this review
sources.read: abstract and structured latent projection equations 22–27; not reproduced
sources.idea: Shared and modality-specific representation preservation; availability routing.
sources.use: Keep independently predictive private streams; shared/private decomposition itself not new.

sources.title: SGMA: Semantic-Guided Modality-Aware Segmentation for Remote Sensing with Incomplete Multimodal Data
sources.authors: Lekang Wen, Liang Liao, Jing Xiao, Mi Wang
sources.read: abstract, SGF/MAS descriptions and experimental discussion; not reproduced
sources.idea: Multiscale class prototypes and modality-aware training sampling.
sources.use: D24 simplified bank is not full SGMA; do not equate its negative result with failure of semantic modeling.

sources.title: Reliability-guided SAR-Optical segmentation under heterogeneous degradation
sources.authors: Mengru Hou, Guowei Su, Tian Qiu, Wenhao Zang, Luobing Dong
sources.read: author preprint metadata and abstract only
sources.idea: Frequency evidence for spatial reliability under heterogeneous sensor degradation.
sources.use: Close novelty neighbor; change SAR to DSM or add semantic gate insufficient novelty.

sources.title: Benchmarking Multi-modal Semantic Segmentation under Sensor Failures: Missing and Noisy Modality Robustness
sources.read: official abstract and metric definitions in abstract
sources.idea: Separate entire missing, random missing and noisy states.
sources.use: Balanced state report is a declared development score, not deployment expectation.

sources.title: Zipper: A Multi-Tower Decoder Architecture for Fusing Modalities
sources.authors: Vicky Zayats, Peter Chen, Melissa Ferrari, Dirk Padfield
sources.status: NeurIPS Efficient Natural Language and Speech Processing Workshop; PMLR262
sources.read: primary proceedings abstract; speech/text results not transferred to imagery
sources.idea: Preserve unimodal towers while learning cross-modal connections.
sources.use: Cross-field architectural motivation for private streams and interaction-only residuals.

sources.title: SynIB: Informational Bottleneck for Maximizing Synergy in Multimodal Learning
sources.idea: Joint-only task information and withheld-modality confidence objective.
sources.use: Use unique/redundant/joint-correction diagnostic lens only; do not copy confidence penalty that conflicts with strong unimodal fallback.
